The query ranks all Montgomery census tracts by listed pharmacies per 10,000 residents, left-joining pharmacy counts and CDC population so zero-count tracts are retained, then orders ascending with nulls last and name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH pharmacy_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_b87122' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
population AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_b87122_m2_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  (COALESCE(pc.pharmacy_count, 0) / NULLIF(p.totalpopulation, 0)) * 10000.0 AS pharmacies_per_10000_residents,
  COALESCE(pc.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
  p.totalpopulation,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN pharmacy_counts pc ON t.geoid = pc.geoid
LEFT JOIN population p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pharmacies_per_10000_residents ASC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
